selected_evidence.requirement: Sum nonnegative decimal counters exactly, including totals above 4 GiB.
selected_evidence.summary: The installed fixture produced 4294967303; a beyond-64-bit test produced 18446744078004518920, including after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Reject invalid or negative records without publishing a partial total.
selected_evidence.summary: Negative, malformed, blank, signed, and underscore-form records exited 1 with stdout_bytes=0; post-restart invalid-input verification also passed.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve the integer-decimal interface and work on the installed architecture and legacy platform.
selected_evidence.summary: The executable remains mode 755, accepts a counters file, emits a newline-terminated decimal integer, and runs using installed Python 3.9.21 on AlmaLinux 9.6 x86_64 with its existing kernel.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart persistence and recovery.
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline and checksums were captured, the reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed from 54bd1c3e-3a1b-4913-841b-88512119e096 to 6bf76a37-10c9-44cc-b942-df4a8169756c, and source/data checksums plus all functional checks recovered.
